note: Held-out rows that an experiment has ALREADY READ are burned for tuning. A number measured on them is no longer out-of-sample, so they may never be used to choose a threshold, a margin, a model, a rung, or any other knob. They remain usable for one thing only: reporting a previously-taken measurement, with its commit. The 42 multilingual rows postdate g15 and are NOT burned.
rule: burn every held-out row that existed when the experiment ran

experiments.what: P4 scope/refusal layer — calibration selection, then one held-out validation (prereg A2)
experiments.read: the whole held-out split for T01/T04/T05
experiments.note: T01's selected configuration was applied on held-out; T04/T05 held-out was scored as a baseline only, because nothing qualified on calibration. Either way the rows were READ, so all three tenants' held-out rows are burned.

not_burned.rows: the 19 held-out multilingual rows (ML-T01-es/fr/ptbr-*, es 7 · fr 7 · pt-BR 5)
not_burned.why: they were authored after g15 ran (commit b28a1de) and no experiment has read them

consequence: Any future retrieval experiment (including the per-language measurement) may select on calibration only. A held-out validation is a single, preregistered read, and it burns the rows it reads.
